part.text:
Fixed. The bug: child processes inherited the shell's raw OS environment via `std::process::Command`'s default env inheritance, so env vars hidden with `hide-env` (or removed via overlays) still leaked to grandchildren.

**Fix** in `crates/nu-command/src/system/run_external.rs:545`: `spawn_simple_command` now calls `process.env_clear()` when building the child `Command`. `create_process` (crates/nu-command/src/system/run_external.rs:498) then applies exactly nushell's rendered environment (`envs(&self.env_vars)`), so children only receive variables visible in the current scope — hidden vars are excluded.

**Validation** (in the testbed container):
- The issue repro (`$env.TEST = 1; ^$nu.current-exe -c "hide-env TEST; ^$nu.current-exe -c '$env.TEST'"`) now errors with "cannot find column 'TEST'" instead of printing `1`
- `hides_environment_from_child` (the FAIL_TO_PASS test) passes
- `cargo test -p nu --test main`: 1231 passed, only two flaky timing-sensitive plugin tests failed (pass in isolation; unrelated)
- `cargo test -p nu-command`: 1480 passed; the 2 failures (`cd_permission_denied_folder`, `rm_prints_filenames_on_error`) fail on baseline too (pre-existing, root-user environment)
- `nu-cmd-lang`, `nu-protocol`, `nu-engine` suites all pass
